post.summary: Create a company; the caller becomes its lead.

put.summary: Invite a user of the organisation to the company, or change their role.

delete.summary: Remove a user from the company.

post.summary: Create a project in the discover stage.

put.summary: Replace an access request; a status change is published as `access-request.status-changed`.
Assign an engineer to the project.

delete.summary: Remove an engineer from the project.

get.summary: The decisions log, newest decision first.

post.summary: Record a decision: what, who decided, when and why. The log is append-only.

get.summary: The project's scope: items in and out of scope, success criteria and the latest sign-off.
The scope's change log, oldest first.

post.summary: Record the customer's sign-off of the current scope version.

put.summary: Move the project to another stage: one forward, or back to any earlier one.

get.summary:
The company's stakeholders, for anyone who works on this project: assignees sign off with them
and name them as owners of access requests.
The company's systems, for anyone who works on this project.
The company's stakeholders: people at the customer.

delete.summary: Remove a stakeholder. Refused (409) once they have signed off a scope.

get.summary: The company's systems: what the work touches at the customer.
The organisation's reusable answers to security questionnaires.

owner.description: The stakeholder at the customer who owns granting it.

days_waiting.description: Whole days from the request until it was settled, or until now while it is open.

decided_by.description: Who decided, often someone at the customer.

content.description:
What the change set: the item or criterion, or for `signed_off` the whole signed scope
(`stakeholder`, `items`, `criteria`). Null for changes logged before content was kept.

signed_off.description: Whether the latest sign-off covers the current version.

version.description: Bumped by every change to the items or criteria.

stakeholder.description: The person at the customer who signed off.

stage.description: One stage forward, or back to any earlier stage.

title.description: Their role at the customer, e.g. "VP Engineering".

blocker.description: What blocks the task; required when the status is `blocked`.
